sources.title: Fragments Of Memories — BLACK/MATRIX 00 プレイ日記
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET A. Directly inspectable 2005 43-entry play diary spanning first clear and later-playthrough/endgame entries. Newly indexed in this pass: BS2 and BS3 occur during chapter 3; BS4 occurs in chapter 4; BS5 `うちの子2` and BS6 `手合わせ` fire back-to-back in one chapter-4 free-action segment before mandatory progression resumes toward ラムシュタイン大聖堂; BS7/8 occur in chapter 5; BS9 in chapter 6; BS10 then BS11 in chapter 7; BS12 in chapter 8; and BS14 in chapter 9, where `セングラー` is visibly consumed during the added event. sources.title: ニコニコ動画 — 〖プレイ動画〗ブラックマトリクスOO (mylist/38903044)

Concrete target parts recovered for focused inspection include chapter 3 `3-4` (`sm22144281`, previous `sm22121454`), chapter 4 `4-1` (`sm22224935`) through `4-5` (`sm22313254`), chapter 7 `7-3` (`sm23977976`), `7-4` (`sm24091204`), `7-5` (`sm24189546`), and chapter 9 `9-4` (`sm24867194`). A browser/session capable of playing NicoNico should inspect only the free-action windows around BS2/3, grouped BS5/6, BS10, and BS14; if the videos visibly perform the trigger chains, record exact observed actions/timing and promote only those directly watched parts into Set B.

sources.title: RPG大辞典倉庫Lv5 — BLACK/MATRIX 00 サーカスED記述
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B supplementary component, directly inspectable in the current accuracy pass. Independently states that Circus ED requires mastering all seven circus minigames (not merely clearing them), then buying D・J; buying D・J immediately triggers the ending regardless of main-story progress. It specifically calls out knife throwing, flyer distribution, and the light game as difficult. The route now uses this live condition and no longer requires the FC2-only `達人ノ書～完～` claim.

disagreements: RESEARCH GATE STATUS AFTER PR #82 ACCURACY FEEDBACK: the 2026-09-23 operational-detail request is not treated as a source-policy waiver. The only owner-approved BLACK/MATRIX exception remains the explicit 2026-09-22 title-scoped exception enumerated in `prompt_supplement.md` (including the six literal NG+ answers for `それぞれの明日` and the previously listed reward/trigger gaps). FFSKY-only BS8/BS12 exact orders, post-5-2 `構成員女×2 → 巡礼する精霊`, and BS13 extra conversations / ordinal choice are supplemental-only in this PR. BS7 has a real order disagreement: TSST says Siria → notebook `よく効く薬` → Fry → one-winged angel (+ another Siria conversation somewhere), while FFSKY says notebook → one-winged angel → Fry → Siria → one-winged angel; the route selects the Japanese TSST order and Set A independently verifies the terminal `紅い` choice. FC2 chapter 5, chapter 8, and ending pages currently return HTTP 403 and are no longer claimed as currently inspectable; their historical excerpts remain provenance only. The six NG+ literals remain reviewable under the already-valid 2026-09-22 exception. Circus ED no longer depends on FC2: live Japanese RPG大辞典 support verifies seven mastered minigames + D・J purchase → immediate Circus ED. Wazap/livedoor/Set A remain live support for ordinary ending/ring structure.
